# East Coast Podiatry

> > Comprehensive podiatry and foot care services across Singapore, offering custom orthotics, sports injury treatment, and specialized care for all ages.

East Coast Podiatry operates multiple clinics across Singapore in Marine Parade, Kembangan, Orchard, Bukit Timah, and Novena, providing evidence-based podiatric treatments including HSA-approved custom orthotics, shockwave therapy, and specialized care for conditions ranging from sports injuries to diabetic foot complications.

## Key Topics

- Custom foot orthotics
- Plantar fasciitis treatment
- Sports injury management
- Shockwave therapy (ESWT/EMTT)
- ITB syndrome and knee pain
- Achilles tendonitis
- Ingrown toenail procedures
- Diabetic foot care
- Children's foot development
- Gait analysis and biomechanics
- Marathon running preparation
- Venous insufficiency and wound care
- Tarsal tunnel syndrome
- Leg length discrepancy
- Singapore healthcare locations

## Core Podiatry Services

- [Custom Foot Orthotics](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/orthotics-shoe-insoles): Custom foot orthotics service with 3D scanning and gait analysis
- [Science of Foot Orthotics](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/science-of-foot-orthotics): HSA-approved custom orthotics science and prescription insole technology
- [Sports Tape](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/sports-taping): Sports taping service for injury prevention and plantar fasciitis support

## Common Foot and Ankle Conditions

- [Tarsal Tunnel Syndrome](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/tarsal-tunnel-syndrome): Tarsal tunnel syndrome causes, symptoms, and EMTT treatment options
- [Venous Insufficiency, Stasis, and Ulceration](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/venous-insufficiency-stasis-and-ulceration): Venous insufficiency symptoms, compression therapy, and wound care treatment
- [Iliotibial Band Syndrome](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/iliotibial-band-syndrome): ITB syndrome in runners and cyclists with shockwave therapy treatment
- [Leg Length Discrepancy](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/leg-length-difference): Leg length discrepancy diagnosis and treatment for structural/functional LLD

## Foot Health Blog and Guides

- [News and Blog](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/blog-post): Main blog hub covering foot and ankle care topics in Singapore
- [Marathon Foot Care Tips](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/blog-post/foot-care-tips-to-prepare-your-feet-for-a-marathon): Marathon preparation tips for Standard Chartered Singapore Marathon runners
- [Running with Knee Pain?](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/blog-post/running-with-knee-pain-should-you-rest-or-push-on): Managing knee pain and ITB syndrome during marathon training
- [Ageing Feet: Common Concerns and Preventive Care](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/blog-post/ageing-feet-common-changes-and-how-to-manage-them): Managing elderly foot pain, sarcopenia, and fall prevention strategies
- [Ingrown Toenails Explained](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/blog-post/ingrown-toenails-explained): Onychocryptosis stages, partial and total nail avulsion procedures explained
- [Monsoon Foot Fungal Risks](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/blog-post/singapores-monsoon-season-and-fungal-foot-infections-what-you-need-to-know): Preventing athlete's foot and fungal toenails during Singapore monsoon season
- [Dangers on Singapore Beaches](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/blog-post/hidden-dangers-of-singapores-beaches): Beach safety tips for preventing foot injuries at East Coast Park
- [Slippers For Children](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/should-your-kids-wear-these): Guidance on choosing appropriate slippers for children's foot development

## Chinese Language Resources (中文资源)

- [脚后跟腱炎 (Achilles Tendonitis)](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/cn_medialibrary/achilles-tendonitis): Chinese guide on Achilles tendonitis causes, symptoms, and treatments
- [发育期疼痛 (Growing Pains)](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/cn_medialibrary/growing-pains): Chinese guide on children's growing pains symptoms and treatments
- [屈趾症 (Curly Toes)](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/cn_medialibrary/curly-toes): Chinese guide on curly toe deformity in children and conservative treatment
- [距骨软骨损伤 (Talar Dome Injuries)](https://www.eastcoastpodiatry.sg/cn_medialibrary/talar-dome): Chinese guide on talar dome injuries and ankle cartilage damage treatment
